course.title: Digital Signal Processing
course.department: Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering

content.value: Assume that a computer terminal has 110 characters (on its keyboard) and that each character is sent by using binary words.
i) What are the number of bits needed to represent each character?
ii) How fast can the characters be sent (characters/s) over a telephone line channel having a bandwidth of 3.2 kHz and an SNR of 20 dB?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2016
